label: Remaining DC Available To Allocate (Net DC Available)
WOC (OH + IT)
extra: {"be_configs": {"sql_alias": "ROUND(COALESCE(SUM((store_in_transit + store_avail_oh) * wos_predicted_oh_it), 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(store_avail_oh), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(store_in_transit), 0), 0), 2) AS wos_predicted_oh_it"}}

label: WOC (OH + OO + IT)
extra: {"be_configs": {"sql_alias": "ROUND(COALESCE(SUM((store_in_transit + store_avail_oh + oo) * wos_predicted), 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(store_avail_oh), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(store_in_transit), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(oo), 0), 0), 2) AS wos_predicted"}}

label: DC Inventory
extra: {"be_configs": {"sql_alias": "ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT COALESCE(it_dc, 0)) + SUM(DISTINCT COALESCE(oo_dc, 0)) + SUM(DISTINCT COALESCE(oh_dc, 0)), 0) AS sum_it_oo_oh"}}
